scenarios.name: exile-from-hand-adds-red
scenarios.why: 'Exile Simian Spirit Guide from your hand: Add {R}' is a special mana action a player may take any time they have priority (CR 701.16a exile): the Ape leaves the hand for exile and one {R} lands in the pool.

scenarios.name: no-offer-on-the-battlefield
scenarios.why: The exiling action names the card in hand; a Simian Spirit Guide that is already on the battlefield does not offer it (the ability only exists from the hand).
